title: Start MVC after removing retired compatibility settings
goal: Migrate MVC startup to ASP.NET Core 11 by removing CompatibilityVersion registrations and retired option types; rebuild applications and dependent libraries that referenced them.

selectionNotes: Migrate MVC startup to ASP.NET Core 11 by removing CompatibilityVersion registrations and retired option types; rebuild applications and dependent libraries that referenced them.
Historical .NET 10 code is comparison-only. The supported replacement already worked on .NET 10; these samples do not add a curated foundation.

runtime.name: .NET / ASP.NET Core
runtime.reason: An ASP.NET Core 11 migration; the recorded execution baseline is RC2, not GA.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the net11.0 consumer with matching framework references; exact reproduction pin is shown.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Tested language mode, not a claim that this migration needs C# 15 syntax. The .NET 10 comparison uses C# 14.

packageAssets: Matching Microsoft.AspNetCore.App shared framework and reference pack; no additional NuGet package
providers: Real MVC dependency injection, routing and Kestrel; no application data provider
platforms: ASP.NET Core supported server platforms; actual evidence is Windows x64
renderingModes: Server MVC controller requests; no Blazor rendering mode
prerequisites: Create the complete QuayArchive directory for one target, including the three empty Directory files that isolate surrounding MSBuild/central package configuration. Use the pinned SDK and restore framework assets before offline builds. Run with the sample directory as the working directory.
constraints: MVC source and binary migration only. Removing the no-op registration does not opt an ASP.NET Core 2.x application into equivalent behavior; a 2.x upgrade needs its own migration analysis.

The removed surfaces include SetCompatibilityVersion for IMvcBuilder and IMvcCoreBuilder, CompatibilityVersion, MvcCompatibilityOptions and ConfigureCompatibilityOptions<TOptions>. Remove usages rather than inventing implementations under the retired names.

The sample proves controller startup and one successful request. It does not prove every MVC option, view, formatter or third-party dependency is compatible. Recompile dependent binaries to avoid removed type/method references.
stabilityLimitations: Stable framework migration; .NET 11 compilation and execution evidence uses 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105. GA reconciliation remains separate.

sources.title: Official ASP.NET Core 11 migration and removed APIs

evidence.scope: Real Kestrel startup and GET /archive/crates/27 return the same representative MVC response on both baselines. Matching-SDK compilation and real execution; no mocks or cross-compilation. Windows x64 evidence does not establish GA or a platform matrix.
